policy_network:
EndToEndVisualActor(
  (encoder): EndToEndVisualEncoder(
    (state_encoder): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=850, out_features=256, bias=True)
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=128, bias=True)
    )
    (depth_encoder): Sequential(
      (0): Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=(5, 5), stride=(2, 2), padding=(2, 2))
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (2): Conv2d(16, 32, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1))
      (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (4): Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1))
      (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    )
    (depth_pool): AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(2, 4))
    (depth_projection): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    )
    (gru): GRU(256, 256)
  )
  (action_mlp): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=341, out_features=512, bias=True)
    (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (4): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (6): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=25, bias=True)
  )
)
critic_network:
Sequential(
  (0): Linear(in_features=780, out_features=512, bias=True)
  (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
  (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (4): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=128, bias=True)
  (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (6): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)

rollout: 100% current policy; no teacher or imitation labels
oracle_semantics: next-stable target positions in the robot anchor frame plus measured, current expected, and next-stable supports; each limb support is encoded as contact, ground, and next-anchor-relative rung divided by rung count
gradient_probe: first sequence microbatch, before updates; PPO surrogate only
snapshot: every 500 updates, first up to 16 envs, complete rollout with before-update weights
hidden_reset: done[t] resets before t+1; GRU every policy step; camera cached at 30 Hz
optimizer: one Adam over the policy-only visual encoder, actor, and privileged critic
